test_title: PYST 20: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Mathematics (Held On: 13 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: A man receives ₹5,140 per month as salary. He saves 35% of his salary every month. His expenditure per month is:
solution:
**Given:**

Monthly salary of the man = ₹5,140

Percentage of salary saved = 35%

**Formula Used:**

Expenditure = Salary - Savings

Savings = (Percentage saved × Salary) / 100

**Calculation:**

Savings = (35 × ₹5,140) / 100

⇒ Savings = ₹1,799

Expenditure = ₹5,140 - ₹1,799

⇒ Expenditure = ₹3,341

**The expenditure per month is ₹3,341.**
